details: This package is an unofficial fork of the Baileys WhatsApp socket library, published under the @kropa scope instead of the upstream @whiskeysockets scope, with several non-upstream insertions that run whenever the library is used. 1. Forced WhatsApp channel follow. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js a bare setTimeout with a 120000 ms delay in makeNewsletterSocket sends a newsletter FOLLOW query for the hardcoded channel id 120363407277177688@newsletter from every socket the host application creates. The response and all errors are swallowed, there is no opt-out, and the account's own WhatsApp identity is enrolled into that channel. 2. Concealed marketing URL injected into outbound messages. lib/Socket/messages-send.js builds its rich-media payload with the host encoded as String.fromCharCode(104,116,116,112,115,58,47,47,102,105,111,114,97,46,110,105,120,101,108,46,109,121,46,105,100,47), which decodes to hxxps://fiora[.]nixel[.]my[.]id/. That URL is set as sourceUrl on every image and video submessage the operator sends, and the video/product helpers replace message body text with "[ CANNOT_LOAD_VIDEO - NIXEL ]" / "[ CANNOT_LOAD_PRODUCT - NIXEL ]". 3. Mandatory phone-home licence gate that terminates the process. makeWASocket in lib/Socket/index.js calls verifyLicenseGuard (lib/Utils/license-guard.js, a javascript-obfuscator bundle whose plaintext source is also shipped as lib/Utils/license-guard.src.js). If no licenceKey / KRISPEDIA_LICENSE value is supplied, or the key is rejected, the package prints a "KRISPEDIA DIGITAL LICENSE GUARD PROTOCOL" banner and calls process.exit(1) and sock.end(), killing the host application. Valid keys, or two hardcoded master keys in the file, are otherwise checked by GET ${LICENSE_SERVER_URL || hxxps://krispedia-license-api[.]vercel[.]app}/api/verify?key=.... The obfuscated file is a compile of the shipped plaintext, not a hidden second payload. No credential, token, wallet or file-content collection was found: the only environment variables read are the licence variables, and there is no access to npm/GitHub/cloud tokens,.npmrc, ~/.ssh or ~/.aws.
